body.statement: If a member of \(\mathcal M_{2,\mathrm{reg}}\) has a centrally symmetric disturbance law, then \(T_3=0\), \(P_3=Q_3=0\), and \(D=0\); the residual information through order three reduces to \(F_{11}=0\), so the one-dimensional order-two query fiber from Theorem 4 remains. This recovers the known covariance nonidentification boundary rather than contradicting it.
body.justification: The reduction verifies that the chart correctly fails when third cumulants contain no information.
body.gap: Non-Gaussianity alone does not exclude symmetric laws; the proposal therefore makes no universal third-order identification claim.
body.consumer: Analysts can interpret a vanishing chart as a certificate failure that includes a familiar symmetric-error boundary.
